question: Where do I check my result and what comes after that?
reference_answer: Check your result on the OIA admission results page for international students (undergraduate), then follow the acceptance guideline that matches the "Korean Language" result on your result page. If you pass or are exempt: print the tuition bill and pay between 18 June and 9 July 2026, submit missing documents by 16 July, then apply for the Certificate of Admission (by 16 July) and your visa. If you did not meet the Korean standard: submit additional language documents or apply to Hanyang IIE, and you will be placed on leave for the first semester.

question: Can I still get a part-time permit?
reference_answer: Possibly, once 6 months have passed since you entered Korea (D-2-8 rule). Without TOPIK Level 4 you can still qualify through the English-track alternative (for example TOEFL iBT 71 or IELTS 5.5); if you meet neither, the limit is 10 hours a week. You also need a previous-semester GPA of at least 2.0.
required_facts: D-2-8 students must wait 6 months from entry or status change before a part-time permit
Year 3-4 students need TOPIK Level 4; English-track students may use TOEFL, IELTS or similar scores instead
Without the Korean standard the limit is 10 hours a week
